bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 拆股后首日，跌破 $93.7

read.en: In its first post-split session (8-for-1, prices adjusted), Sandisk fell 16.1% on Nov 20 to $79.24, its lowest close since Mar 30, range $78.25–90.67. It is below the 5-day ($94.3), 10-day ($104.0), 30-day ($138.9) and 100-day ($179.0), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($160.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($121.83), and RSI is 25.4.
read.zh: 闪迪 11月20日起按 1 拆 8 后交易（所有价格均已按拆股调整），当日下跌 16.1%，收于 $79.24，为 3月30日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $78.25–90.67。股价位于 5 日（$94.3）、10 日（$104.0）、30 日（$138.9）和 100 日均线（$179.0）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$160.7）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$121.83），RSI 为 25.4。

read.en: The drop broke the $93.7–94.2 support (Nov 17 and 18 lows, $750 pre-split), now resistance; the $87.5 ($700 pre-split) level also gave way. Resistance is $83.5–86.4 (February highs), then $89.9–90.7 (Nov 20 open and high) and $93.7–94.4. Support is $78.25 (Nov 20 low), then $71.6–71.8 (Mar 30 close, Feb 18 low) and $67.5–69.8. A close above $86.4 would target $90–90.7; below $78.25, $71.6–71.8.

r.en: Nov 17 and 18 lows $93.67–94.23 ($750 pre-split), lost; 5-day average $94.3; Nov 19 close $94.39
